domain: Equal-weight fermion gauge and scalar trace at Q; nD=2,nT=1 or 2 Dirac multiplets with independent invariant masses anywhere between MZ and Q satisfying all three gauge equations. No direct Yukawa of these extra charged multiplets in the baseline; step matching for gauge couplings, one-Higgs running below Q. Independent two-width gauge inputs and one-width ordinary Yukawa/quartic inputs.
